name: RAG corpus assistant
product: the RAG pipeline's question box, which answers from 35 Wikipedia articles (SQuAD 2.0)
description: Answers factual, encyclopedia-style questions. Its library is 35 Wikipedia articles: 1973 oil crisis, Amazon rainforest, Black Death, Civil disobedience, Computational complexity theory, Construction, Ctenophora, Economic inequality, European Union law, Force, French and Indian War, Fresno (California), Geology, Harvard University, Huguenot, Immune system, Imperialism, IPCC, Islamism, Jacksonville (Florida), Normans, Oxygen, Packet switching, Pharmacy, Prime number, Private school, Rhine, Scottish Parliament, Sky (United Kingdom), Southern California, Steam engine, University of Chicago, Victoria (Australia), Warsaw, Yuan dynasty. A factual question outside the library is still in scope: the pipeline searches and says when it finds nothing.
